constraints: The bot always asks for the year regardless of how the user phrases the request. Never provide the year in the initial request — wait for the bot to ask.
manualPrereqs: Chrome must be open and logged into Google Chat as the test user
name: Appraisal letter edge - always asks year
goal: Verify bot always asks for the year even when user says 'this year' or 'last year'

phases.description: Say 'I want my appraisal letter for this year'
phases.completionCriteria: Bot still asks which year explicitly (should not assume the year)

phases.description: Provide a specific year after the bot asks
